# Forge To Table

> > Handcrafted Japanese-style kitchen knives and accessories for home cooks and professional chefs, founded by Noah Rosen and Carole Zheng in Chicago.

Forge To Table specializes in premium handmade Japanese-style knives featuring AUS10 and VG10 steel, complemented by carefully curated kitchen accessories and tools. The site combines product catalogs with culinary content, offering both individual knives and bundled sets for various cooking needs.

## Key Topics

- Gyuto (Chef's Knife)
- Santoku
- Bunka
- Japanese-style knives
- Handcrafted/Handmade
- AUS10 Steel
- VG10 Steel
- Sakimaru Takobiki (Sashimi Slicer)
- Magnetic Knife Block
- Kitchen Accessories
- Knife Storage
- Chef Knife Sets
- Cleaver
- Japanese Steel
- Saya (Knife Sheath)

- [7" Bunka Chef Knife](https://www.forgetotable.com/product-page/7-bunka): 7" Bunka Chef Knife with Japanese VG10 steel for precision cutting tasks
- [10" Sakimaru Takobiki (Katana Slicer)](https://www.forgetotable.com/product-page/10-sakimaru-takobiki-katana-slicer): Specialized sashimi slicer for sushi chefs and professional fish filleting
- [Classic Cleaver](https://www.forgetotable.com/product-page/classic-cleaver): Classic Cleaver inspired by traditional Chinese knife craftsmanship for heavy-duty cutting
